description: Event-centered semantic sequence for defensive tackle action

frames.label: tack-before
frames.description: Pre-commitment: human defender steers toward the CPU carrier

frames.label: tack-input
frames.description: Tackle input tick: STANDING_TACKLE_BIT pressed, phase machine enters prepare

frames.label: tack-active
frames.description: Active window opens: finite-reach contact eligible in forward cone

frames.label: tack-contact
frames.description: Tackle contact: standing tackle's active-window duel contact on the CPU carrier (player-player contact + velocity-only separation impulse); the follow-up tackle press is rejected by the recovery lock-out and the ball is untouched at this tick

frames.label: tack-recovery
frames.description: Recovery window: body speed capped, lock-out prevents instant re-tackle
